bio: Hello! My name is John Kim, and I am a first-year student from Seoul, South Korea. I currently live in Canaday Hall and plan to concentrate in Social Studies. Outside of FYSC, I play violin in the Harvard-Radcliffe Orchestra and in chamber music ensembles. I am also part of the Harvard Crimson (Multimedia) and the Health Policy Program at the Institute of Politics. In my free time, I love to take a walk by the Charles River or grab a meal/dessert in the square with my friends. So excited to help create special first-year memories through FYSC, and I hope I can contribute to bringing joy and inclusivity for our class :)
